description:
Single storey outbuilding in rear garden to be used as home office/gym and store (demolition of shed) 
Amendment to approved application P/1585/21 increase in height of proposed out building.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the  side elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p>The detached outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the occupiers of 12 Water Gardens,&nbsp;Stanmore, HA7 3QA&nbsp;&nbsp;and shall at no point be used as primary living accommodation, rental purposes or any other similar use.</p>

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height:107%">Reasonable Exemption Statement, PR25-025a, PR25-025b, PR25-025c, PR25-025d, Arboricultural Impact Assessment Method Statement &amp; Tree Protection Plan (ref: TH 3300, dated 10/03/2022), Flood Risk Assessment (00561AB 12 Water Gardens) (received 27/08/2025), Drainage Plan and SUDs (PR25-FDS-025c) (received 27/08/2025), Construction Details of the Proposed Soakaway,&nbsp; Flood Displacement Storage (PR25-FDS-025c)(received 02/09/2025)&nbsp;</span>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The development shall be implemented in accordance with the details contained in the
approved Arboricultural Impact
Assessment Method statement &amp; Tree Protection Plan prepared dated 10/03/2022 and shall remain in place and effective for the duration of
the construction works or development, as applicable.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
